### Setup
`base_url` is a plain config field, editable from this app's own Settings gear — defaults to `http://aw-skills:10016`, a container **name** on `aw-stack-net` (same pattern as the Knowledgeable Connector), not the public hostname. Only change it to point this connector at a different aw-skills deployment.

There is no secret to configure: this app mints and refreshes its own per-workspace identity token against aw-backend (`identity_token.py`) on an hourly watchdog tick.

### Known duplication (temporary)
The `kb` app also exposes `search_skills`/`load_skill` (gateway-prefixed `aw__kb__*`), reading this workspace's local `skills/` tree — a different, filesystem-backed index from skills.aw's own content-owning registry these `aw__skills__*` tools talk to. Both pairs work today; deprecating the `kb` app's pair is a later phase of the aw-skills build, not this one. See this repo's README.

### Verify
Calls `search_skills` for real against the configured skills.aw instance.
